page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance type.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU, the ecs.r8i.12xlarge is classified as a memory-optimized instance. This resource profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data processing applications that require substantial RAM capacity relative to compute resources. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
